title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (Helm + Terraform automation)
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Adds automation for tenant RBAC bootstrap used by Private installer flows: Helm chart hooks, Terraform module support, and an idempotent bootstrap script. Motivation: make tenant creation for Private (VPC / on-prem) deployments reproducible and auditable, avoid manual kubeconfig operations during initial installer runs, and provide least-privilege default roles for tenant isolation. This PR includes: 1) Helm chart template changes to install a tenant-rbac ClusterRole/Role and RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding with templated tenant IDs and optional namespace scoping; 2) A Terraform module (modules/rbac/bootstrap) that wraps Helm + Kubernetes provider resources and exposes inputs for tenant_id, allowed_namespaces, and bootstrap_service_account; 3) An idempotent installer script (installer/scripts/bootstrap_roles.sh) used by the Private installer to kick off bootstrap via either Helm or Terraform; 4) Integration tests and README updates documenting operator/service-account flows and recommended KMS permission boundaries. Checklist: [x] Helm templates and tests [x] Terraform module and examples [x] Installer script and idempotency checks [x] E2E smoke test for tenant creation [x] Security review comments addressed. Breaking change: none. Migration notes: Existing on-prem installs that opt into automated bootstrap must provide a bootstrap service account with minimal permissions; manual migration steps included in README.
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial terraform module and example, helm templates for tenant-rbac with templating, installer script + idempotency, tests and CI updates, docs/README additions, fix: tighten Role permissions per security review.
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we avoid creating ClusterRoleBindings by default? Prefer namespace-scoped Roles where possible. Please add a toggle and document the security implications.
Aisha Kapoor: Good call — added 'cluster_scope' boolean input to the Terraform module and a Helm value 'rbac.clusterScope' with default false. Updated README with guidance.
Mateo Ruiz: Tests look good but e2e failed on first run due to timing with k8s RBAC propagation; suggest adding a retry with exponential backoff in the installer script.
Aisha Kapoor: Added backoff + jitter and increased test wait timeout to 90s. Rerunning e2e passed locally.
Priya Narang: Security scan flagged wildcards in one role; please tighten to explicit verbs/resources.
Aisha Kapoor: Replaced wildcards with explicit verbs (get,list,watch,create,update) and limited resources to our custom tenant CRDs and namespaces. Rescan now clean.

Local test command: make test-e2e TARGET=rbac-bootstrap. Example terraform apply demo available under terraform/examples/tenant-bootstrap.

For air-gapped installs, ensure Helm chart assets are mirrored; Terraform uses the cluster's Kubernetes provider credentials. Monitor 'rbac.bootstrap' metric emitted by installer hooks.
